--- keys

--- expect
hello wor|ld
--- note
Undo with nothing to undo is a no-op. The document was opened and the caret
placed, but no edit has been made, so the history holds no change to reverse.
Undo must leave the text and the caret exactly as they are: it must not move
the caret, must not mutate the document, and must not swallow the placement as
if it were an undoable action. Any change to the rendered state here would mean
undo acted on an empty history.
